value: Entry comes by a raid-scale diversion. Xi’ri and the Sha’tar draw Illidan’s defenders outward while Akama, Maiev and the Deathsworn move on the fortress. Maiev pursues her own vengeance, and Akama continues with his people when she breaks from the plan. At the southern wall they pass through an opening; the account leaves the rest of the temple’s defences untold.
